# EWS outgoing send allows an absent status observer

The original fix changes the unused status observer to Option and sends null in the Basic-auth test. The current shared outgoing API keeps an optional observer, with its later nsIMsgProgress type distinguished from the original nsIMsgStatusFeedback. The test waits for its outgoing listener and checks the Authorization header. That check does not prove mail delivery, progress UI or every invite path. No send test ran.

Scope: Outgoing send nullable observer and Basic-auth test call.
